oracleReaderQuery.value:
SELECT DISTINCT
    r.proj_id project_id,
    proj.description Project_Title,
    r.r_id,
    r.r_code requisition_no,
    r_nls.short_desc Req_Short_Desc,
    r_nls.Description Req_Desc,
    r.r_supp req_rev,
    r.created_date req_created_date,
    r.rel_to_proc_date released_to_proc,
    r.approved_date req_approved_date,
    r.proc_acknowledge_date proc_ack_date
FROM
  m_sys.m_reqs r, 
  m_sys.m_req_nls r_nls,
  m_sys.m_projects proj
WHERE 1=1
  AND r.proj_id = '@{pipeline().parameters.proj_id}'
  AND r.proj_id = proj.proj_id
  AND r.r_code like '%MR%'
  AND r.actual_ind = 'N'
  AND r.r_supp = '0'
  AND r.r_id = r_nls.r_id
  AND r_nls.nls_id = 1
ORDER BY project_id, r.r_code

SELECT o1."LP_ID",o1."LST_ID",o1."STAT_ID",o1."IDENT",o1."DP_ID",o1."LN_ID",o1."SPEC_HEADER_ID",o1."PROJ_ID",o1."LIST_STATUS",o1."ISSUE_STATUS",o1."POS",o1."IDENT_CODE",o1."TAG_NUMBER",o1."IDENT_DESCRIPTION",o1."QUANTITY",o1."SHORT_CODE",o1."OPTION_CODE",o1."SPEC_CODE",o1."SIZE1",o1."SIZE2",o1."SIZE3",o1."UNIT",o1."UNIT_WGHT",o1."BOM_CNTNO",o1."BOM_SFI",o1."BOM_HOLD",o1."BOM_PRESERVATION",o1."BOM_CLIMATE_CONTROL",o1."CLIENT_PRICE_BREAKDOWN",o1."UNIT_WGHT_UOM",o1."REMARKS",o1."XS_TYPE",o1."ITEM_TYPE",o1."MP_SIZE1",o1."MP_SIZE2",o1."MP_SIZE3",o1."MP_SIZE4",o1."MP_SIZE5",o1."XS_ACTIVITY_CODE",o1."XS_ACTIVITY_DESC",o1."MP_SELECT_PRIO",o1."MP_DELV_DESIG",o1."MP_ROS_DATE",o1."MP_FAB_LOCATION",o1."MP_SELECT_CWA",o1."MP_SELECT_CWP",o1."MP_SELECT_WBS",o1."MP_SELECT_IWP",o1."MP_PROCESS_LINE",o1."XS_DRAWING_NUMBER",o1."MP_DRWG_NAME",o1."DRAWING_REV",o1."MP_SEQ_NO",o1."POS_ITR",o1."MAIN_CONN_NUM",o1."MAIN_CONN_TYPE",o1."MAIN_CONN_LOC",o1."REDUCED_CONN_NUM",o1."REDUCED_CONN_TYPE",o1."REDUCED_CONN_LOC",o1."COMMODITY",o1."PAINT_CODE",o1."RTRREQ",o1."LPIREQ",o1."MPIREQ",o1."PWHT",
discipline, type, Unit_module_group, Area_cwa_deck, Element,Bom_drawing_no,
MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(o1.ln_id,'MTO_TYPE') mto_type,
bom_path -- added latter
FROM
    (SELECT lp.lp_id, lp.lst_id, lp.stat_id, lp.ident, lp.dp_id,
      lp.ln_id, lp.spec_header_id,
      lp.proj_id,
      lst_code list_status,
      ms.status issue_status,
      lp.lp_pos pos,
      ident_code,
      lp.tag_number,
      m_sys.m_pck_std_custom.ident_desc(lp.ident, 1) ident_description,
      lp.quantity,
      lp.short_code,
      lp.option_code,
      (SELECT sh.spec_code FROM  m_sys.m_spec_headers sh WHERE lp.spec_header_id = sh.spec_header_id) spec_code,
      lp.input_1 size1,
      lp.input_2 size2,
      lp.input_3 size3,
      (SELECT unit_code FROM m_sys.m_units un WHERE un.unit_id=lp.unit_id) unit,
	        (SELECT ity_code FROM m_sys.m_item_types WHERE ity_id=lp.ity_id) ITEM_TYPE, --added later
      DECODE((SELECT cg_group_code
          FROM m_sys.M_COMMODITY_GROUPS g,m_sys.m_commodity_codes c,m_sys.m_idents i
          WHERE g.group_id = c.group_id
          AND c.commodity_id = i.commodity_id
          AND i.ident=lp.ident),'TP',
         (SELECT attr_value
          FROM m_sys.M_IDENT_VALUES iv,m_sys.m_attrs a
          WHERE iv.ident =lp.ident
          AND a.attr_id=iv.attr_id
          AND attr_code='WEIGHT_UNIT'
          AND rownum=1),
     (SELECT  gd.output_1
      FROM m_sys.m_geom_details gd,m_sys.m_commodity_geometric_relation gr, m_sys.m_idents i
         WHERE gr.commodity_id =i.commodity_id
         AND i.ident =lp.ident
         AND gr.gn_id IN (SELECT gn_id FROM m_sys.m_geom_names WHERE gn_code LIKE '%WGHT%')
         AND gd.gn_id = gr.gn_id AND i.commodity_id =gr.commodity_id AND i.input_1 = gd.input_1
         AND  i.input_2 = gd.input_2 AND  i.input_3 = gd.input_3 AND  i.input_4 = gd.input_4
         AND  i.input_5 = gd.input_5 AND ROWNUM=1)) unit_wght,
      MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_LP_ATTR_VALUE(lp.lp_id,'BOM_CNTNO') bom_cntno,
      MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_LP_ATTR_VALUE(lp.lp_id,'BOM_SFI') bom_sfi,
      MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_LP_ATTR_VALUE(lp.lp_id,'BOM_HOLD') bom_hold,
      MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_LP_ATTR_VALUE(lp.lp_id,'BOM_PRESERVATION') bom_preservation,
      MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_LP_ATTR_VALUE(lp.lp_id,'BOM_CLIM_CONT_STOR') bom_climate_control,
      MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_LP_ATTR_VALUE(lp.lp_id,'CLIENT_PRICE_BREAKDOWN') client_price_breakdown,
      MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_IDENT_CMS_ATTR_VAL(lp.ident,'XS_WEIGHT_UNIT','N') unit_wght_uom,
      MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_LP_ATTR_VALUE(lp.lp_id,'REMARKS') remarks,
      MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_LP_ATTR_VALUE(lp.lp_id,'XS_TYPE') XS_TYPE,
      MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_LP_ATTR_VALUE(lp.lp_id,'MP_SIZE1') MP_SIZE1,
      MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_LP_ATTR_VALUE(lp.lp_id,'MP_SIZE2') MP_SIZE2,
      MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_LP_ATTR_VALUE(lp.lp_id,'MP_SIZE3') MP_SIZE3,
      MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_LP_ATTR_VALUE(lp.lp_id,'MP_SIZE4') MP_SIZE4,
      MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_LP_ATTR_VALUE(lp.lp_id,'MP_SIZE5') MP_SIZE5,
      MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_LP_ATTR_VALUE(lp.lp_id,'XS_ACTIVITY_CODE') XS_ACTIVITY_CODE,
      MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_LP_ATTR_VALUE(lp.lp_id,'XS_ACTIVITY_DESC') XS_ACTIVITY_DESC,
      MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_LP_ATTR_VALUE(lp.lp_id,'MP_SELECT_PRIO') MP_SELECT_PRIO,
      MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_LP_ATTR_VALUE(lp.lp_id,'MP_DELV_DESIG') MP_DELV_DESIG,
      MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_LP_ATTR_VALUE(lp.lp_id,'MP_ROS_DATE') MP_ROS_DATE,
      MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_LP_ATTR_VALUE(lp.lp_id,'MP_FAB_LOCATION') MP_FAB_LOCATION,
      MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_LP_ATTR_VALUE(lp.lp_id,'MP_SELECT_CWA') MP_SELECT_CWA,
      MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_LP_ATTR_VALUE(lp.lp_id,'MP_SELECT_CWP') MP_SELECT_CWP,
      MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_LP_ATTR_VALUE(lp.lp_id,'MP_SELECT_WBS') MP_SELECT_WBS,
      MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_LP_ATTR_VALUE(lp.lp_id,'MP_SELECT_IWP') MP_SELECT_IWP,
      MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_LP_ATTR_VALUE(lp.lp_id,'MP_PROCESS_LINE') MP_PROCESS_LINE,
      MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_LP_ATTR_VALUE(lp.lp_id,'XS_DRAWING_NUMBER') XS_DRAWING_NUMBER,
      MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_LP_ATTR_VALUE(lp.lp_id,'MP_DRWG_NAME') MP_DRWG_NAME,

      MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_LP_ATTR_VALUE(lp.lp_id,'MP_SEQ') MP_SEQ_NO,
     m_sys.m_pck_bom.list_path_to_root (ln.ln_id, '/') bom_path, -- added latter
	 --below added later
	  MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_LP_ATTR_VALUE(lp.lp_id,'ITEM_TYPE') POS_ITR,

    WHERE lp.dp_id    = (SELECT dp_id FROM m_sys.m_disciplines WHERE dp_code = 'PIPING')
    AND   ln.proj_id  = lp.proj_id
    AND   ln.ln_id    = lp.ln_id
    AND   lp.stat_id  = ms.stat_id
    AND   lp.ident    = inn.ident
    AND   lp.lst_id   = lst.lst_id
    AND   lp.spec_header_id = sh.spec_header_id(+)
    AND (sh.spr_id = (SELECT MAX(spr_id)
                      FROM m_sys.m_spec_headers sh2
                      WHERE sh2.proj_id = lp.proj_id
                      AND  sh.spec_code  = sh2.spec_code) OR sh.spr_id is NULL)

     FROM (
         SELECT ln.ln_id, ln.proj_id,
                MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'DISCIPLINE') discipline,
                MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'TYPE') Type,
                (Case When MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'UNIT') is not null then MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'UNIT')
                When MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'MODULE') is not null then MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'MODULE')
                When MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'GROUP') is not null then MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'GROUP')
                else '' END) Unit_module_group,
                (Case When MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'AREA') is not null then MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'AREA')
                When MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'CWA') is not null then MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'CWA')
                When MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'DECK') is not null then MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'DECk')
                else '' END) Area_cwa_deck,
               -- MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'ELEMENT') Element,
			   (Case When MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'ELEMENT')is not null then MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'ELEMENT')
                      When MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'P_LINE')is not null then MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'P_LINE')
                 ELSE '' END) Element,
                (Case When MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'BOM')is not null then MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'BOM')
                      When MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'DRAWING_NO') is not null then MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'DRAWING_NO')
					  When MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'SPOOL') is not null then MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'SPOOL')
                ELSE '' END) Bom_drawing_no
         FROM m_sys.m_list_nodes ln
         WHERE 1=1
         AND ln.proj_id = '@{pipeline().parameters.proj_id}'
         AND ln.ln_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT ln_id FROM m_sys.m_list_pos lp1 WHERE lp1.dp_id IN (SELECT dp_id FROM m_sys.m_disciplines WHERE dp_code IN ('PIPING')))
         )
    ) o2
WHERE o1.ln_id   = o2.ln_id
AND   o1.proj_id = o2.proj_id
AND   o1.stat_id  = MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_BEST_QUANTITY(o1.proj_id,o1.dp_id, o1.ln_id) -- filter by Best Quantity
ORDER BY discipline, type, Unit_module_group, Area_cwa_deck, Element,Bom_drawing_no, TO_NUMBER(pos)

                      WHERE sh2.proj_id = lp.proj_id
                      AND  sh.spec_code  = sh2.spec_code) OR sh.spr_id is NULL)
   AND ln.proj_id = '@{pipeline().parameters.proj_id}') o1,
    (SELECT *

         SELECT ln.ln_id, ln.proj_id,
                MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'DISCIPLINE') discipline,
                MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'TYPE') Type,

                When MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'MODULE') is not null then MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'MODULE')

                      When MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'P_LINE')is not null then MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'P_LINE')

                ELSE '' END) Bom_drawing_no
         FROM m_sys.m_list_nodes ln
         WHERE 1=1
         AND ln.proj_id = '@{pipeline().parameters.proj_id}'
         AND ln.ln_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT ln_id FROM m_sys.m_list_pos lp1 WHERE lp1.dp_id IN (SELECT dp_id FROM m_sys.m_disciplines WHERE dp_code IN ('PIPING')))
         )
    ) o2
WHERE o1.ln_id   = o2.ln_id
AND   o1.proj_id = o2.proj_id
AND   o1.stat_id  = MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_BEST_QUANTITY(o1.proj_id,o1.dp_id, o1.ln_id) -- filter by Best Quantity
ORDER BY discipline, type, Unit_module_group, Area_cwa_deck, Element,Bom_drawing_no, TO_NUMBER(pos)

oracleReaderQuery.value:
SELECT DISTINCT
    poh.proj_id project_id,
    proj.description Project_Title,
    r.r_id,
    r.r_code requisition_no,
    r_nls.short_desc Req_Short_Desc,
    r_nls.Description Req_Desc,
    r.r_supp req_rev,
    TO_CHAR(r.created_date, 'DD-MON-YYYY') req_created_date,
    TO_CHAR(r.rel_to_proc_date, 'DD-MON-YYYY') released_to_proc,
    TO_CHAR(r.approved_date, 'DD-MON-YYYY') req_approved_date,
    TO_CHAR(r.proc_acknowledge_date, 'DD-MON-YYYY') proc_ack_date,
    poh.po_number,
    poh.po_supp po_rev,
    (SELECT description from m_sys.m_po_header_nls WHERE poh_id=poh.poh_id AND nls_id=1 AND ROWNUM<2) po_title,
    MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_PO_STATUS(poh.poh_id, 'N') po_status,
    MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_PO_STATUS_DATE(poh.poh_id, 'N') status_date,
    TO_CHAR(poh.approved_date, 'DD-MON-YYYY') po_approved_date,
    TO_CHAR(poh.po_issue_date, 'DD-MON-YYYY') po_issue_date,
    ROUND(tc.total_price+NVL(tc.tax_amount,0),2) total_cost_po,
    (SELECT unit_code FROM m_sys.m_units WHERE unit_id=poh.currency_id AND ROWNUM<2) currency_po,
    ROUND(MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_AMOUNT_USD(r.proj_id, SYSDATE,tc.currency_id,(tc.total_price+NVL(tc.tax_amount,0))),2) total_in_usd,
    (SELECT company_name FROM m_sys.m_companies WHERE company_id=ms.company_id AND ROWNUM<2) supplier_name,
    ms.sup_code supplier_code,
    (SELECT description FROM m_sys.m_country_nls WHERE cy_id=ms.cy_id AND nls_id=1 AND ROWNUM<2) supplier_location,
    (SELECT job_number  FROM m_sys.m_jobs WHERE job_id=poh.job_id AND ROWNUM<2) account_code_po
FROM
    m_sys.m_reqs r,
    m_sys.m_req_nls r_nls,
    m_sys.m_po_headers poh,
    m_sys.m_projects proj,
    m_sys.m_po_total_costs tc,
    m_sys.m_overview_suppliers ms,
    (SELECT r_id, poh_id
        FROM
        (
          SELECT DISTINCT min_r_id r_id, min_poh_id poh_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY base_poh_id ORDER BY min_r_id DESC) row_num
          FROM 
          (
              SELECT MIN(get_r.r_id) min_r_id, MIN(poh.poh_id) min_poh_id, poh.base_poh_id
                FROM
                  (SELECT r.r_id, CONNECT_BY_ROOT r_id as this_is_root
                    FROM m_sys.m_reqs r
                       WHERE r.proj_id  = '@{pipeline().parameters.proj_id}'
                          AND r.actual_ind = 'Y'
                          AND r.approved_date is not null  --TR
                          START WITH last_r_id IS NULL
                          CONNECT BY last_r_id = PRIOR r.r_id
                  ) get_r,
                   m_sys.m_req_to_pos rp,
                   m_sys.m_po_headers poh
          WHERE rp.proj_id     = '@{pipeline().parameters.proj_id}'
                AND   rp.proj_id = poh.proj_id
                AND   rp.rli_id IS NULL
                AND   ( rp.rli_id IS NULL AND poh.order_type <> 'SC' OR poh.order_type = 'SC')
                AND   rp.r_id        = get_r.r_id
                AND   rp.base_poh_id = poh.base_poh_id
                AND m_sys.m_pck_config_custom.mdr_get_po_status(poh.poh_id) <> 'CANCELLED'  -- remove cancelled POs
                GROUP BY this_is_root, poh.base_poh_id
          )
          )
          WHERE row_num < 31) req_po
      WHERE poh.proj_id = r.proj_id
      AND poh.proj_id = proj.proj_id
      AND r.r_id = r_nls.r_id
      AND r_nls.nls_id = 1
      AND r.r_id        = req_po.r_id
      AND r.actual_ind = 'Y'
      AND poh.poh_id    = req_po.poh_id
      AND poh.sup_id    = ms.sup_id(+)
      AND poh.poh_id    = tc.poh_id(+)
ORDER BY project_id, po_number

  (select max(attv.short_desc) from M_Sys.M_Used_Values Uv, M_Sys.M_Attrs Att, m_sys.m_attr_values attv
     Where  Uv.Proj_Id    = poh.proj_id
      And   Uv.Attr_Id    = Att.Attr_Id
      And   Att.Attr_Code = 'PAYMENT_MODE'
      And   Uv.Pk_Id      = poh.poh_id
      And   Uv.Used_Type  = 'PO'
      And   Attv.attr_value = Uv.attr_value
      And   Rownum < 2) Payment_Mode_Oracle,
  (select max(attv.short_desc)
    From M_Sys.M_Used_Values Uv, M_Sys.M_Attrs Att, m_sys.m_attr_values attv
    Where Uv.Proj_Id    = poh.proj_id
     And   Uv.Attr_Id    = Att.Attr_Id
     And   Att.Attr_Code = 'JDE_PAY_TERMS'
     And   Uv.Pk_Id      = poh.poh_id
     And   Uv.Used_Type  = 'PO'
     And   Attv.attr_value = Uv.attr_value
     And   Rownum < 2) Payment_Term_JDE
  from m_sys.m_po_headers poh,  MVP_ATTP_WORKLOAD MAW, m_sys.m_overview_suppliers os , m_sys.m_po_total_costs tc, m_sys.m_units u
  where POH.POH_ID = MAW.PK_ID 
  --MZ and poh.po_number like :A_PO_NUM
  and poh.proj_id = ('@{pipeline().parameters.proj_id}')
  and poh.sup_id = os.sup_id 
  and tc.poh_id(+) = poh.poh_id 
  and poh.po_supp IN (
  select max(poh1.po_supp)from m_sys.m_po_headers poh1 
  where poh1.po_number =poh.po_number and poh1.proj_id = poh.proj_id --and poh1.order_type = 'PO'
  and poh1.approved_date is not null 
  group by poh1.po_number)
  and poh.currency_id = u.unit_id
  and nvl(tc.Total_Price,0) > 0 -- only PO Total above Zero Values -- Requested by Jamie 12-nov-2024
  order by poh.po_number,poh.po_supp, maw.attp_order_seq

SELECT DISTINCT
  project_id, requisition_no, req_rev, req_originator, req_date, released_to_proc, proc_ack_date,
  DECODE((SELECT NVL(attr_char3, 'NOTAVAILABLE') FROM m_sys.m_projects WHERE proj_id = project_id),
  'PROJECT', mdr_pack_number,
  'MRO', (SELECT  mg_code FROM m_sys.m_material_groups mgg WHERE mgg.mg_id=get_mg_id),
  DECODE(mdr_pack_number, '-', (SELECT  mg_code FROM m_sys.m_material_groups mgg WHERE mgg.mg_id=get_mg_id), mdr_pack_number)
  ) matl_wrk_grp,
  DECODE((SELECT NVL(attr_char3, 'NOTAVAILABLE') FROM m_sys.m_projects WHERE proj_id = project_id),
  'PROJECT', (SELECT UNIQUE n.description FROM m_sys.m_material_group_nls n,m_sys.m_material_groups g WHERE mdr_pack_number = g.mg_code AND n.mg_id=g.mg_id AND n.nls_id=1),
  'MRO',(SELECT n.description FROM m_sys.m_material_group_nls n WHERE n.mg_id=get_mg_id),
  DECODE(mdr_pack_number, '-',(SELECT n.description FROM m_sys.m_material_group_nls n WHERE n.mg_id=get_mg_id),
  (SELECT UNIQUE n.description FROM m_sys.m_material_group_nls n,m_sys.m_material_groups g WHERE mdr_pack_number = g.mg_code AND n.mg_id=g.mg_id AND n.nls_id=1))
  ) matl_wrk_nls,
  rli_pos, rli_sub_pos,  released_qty, uom, ros_date, po_number, po_rev, po_description, po_status, status_date, 
  po_created_date, po_issue_date, po_approved_date, 
  supplier_code, supplier_name, supplier_location, country_of_origin,
  buyer,  select_code, payment_mode, commodity_code, ident_code,  item_desc,
  poli_pos, poli_sub_pos, account_code_item, poli_uom, poli_qty,
  unit_price_item, po_line_item_price,
  ROUND(get_exchange_rate * (poli_qty * poli_unit_price), 2) po_line_item_price_usd,
  po_total_cost, ROUND(get_exchange_rate * (total_price+tax_amount), 2) po_total_usd, po_currency, currency_po_item, 
  discount_percentage, incoterm, delivery_place,Group1,Group2,Group3,Group4,Group5, prom_delivery_date, 
  mrr_number, mrr_creation_date, mrr_recv_date, mrr_posted_date, mrr_quantity, is_master_tag
FROM
(
SELECT -- first select
get_poh.proj_id project_id, r.r_code requisition_no, r.r_supp req_rev, dummy_poli.poli_id,
	TO_CHAR(r.created_date, 'DD-MON-YYYY') req_date,                    
	(SELECT /*+ index(u USR_PK) */  first_name||' '||last_name FROM m_sys.m_users u WHERE u.m_usr_id=r.originator AND ROWNUM<2) req_originator,
	TO_CHAR(r.rel_to_proc_date, 'DD-MON-YYYY') released_to_proc,
	TO_CHAR(r.proc_acknowledge_date, 'DD-MON-YYYY') proc_ack_date,
	r.mg_id get_mg_id,
	(SELECT attr_value 
    FROM m_sys.m_used_values uv, m_sys.m_attrs att
    WHERE uv.proj_id    = get_poh.proj_id
    AND   uv.attr_id    = att.attr_id
    AND   att.attr_code = 'MDR_PACKAGE_NUMBER'
    AND   uv.pk_id      = r.r_id
    AND   uv.used_type  = 'ER'
    AND   ROWNUM < 2) mdr_pack_number,                     
	rli.rli_pos, rli.rli_sub_pos,
 (SELECT /*+ index(cc CC_PK) */ commodity_code from m_sys.m_commodity_codes cc WHERE cc.commodity_id=i.commodity_id AND ROWNUM<2) commodity_code,
	i.ident_code,
	i.ident,
	REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(LTRIM(MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM_bir.GET_IDENT_DESC_WITH_DEVIATION(i.ident, dummy_poli.poli_id, 'POLI'),'-'),'^-'||' ?',''), CHR(13), ' '), CHR(10), ' '),'- ','') item_desc,  
	rli.total_release_qty released_qty,
	rli.unit_code uom,               
	TO_CHAR(rli.estimated_ros_date, 'DD-MON-YYYY') ros_date,
	get_poh.poh_id, get_poh.buyer, get_poh.po_number, get_poh.po_rev,  get_poh.po_description,
	dummy_poli.poli_pos, dummy_poli.poli_sub_pos,
	(CASE
		WHEN (NVL(tc.total_price, 0) + NVL(dummy_poli.poli_qty, 0) = 0) THEN                           
		   DECODE((SUM(dummy_poli.poli_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY get_poh.poh_id, dummy_poli.poli_id)), 0, 'CANCELLED', get_poh.get_po_status) -- check if cancel
		ELSE                          
		  get_poh.get_po_status -- check without cancel 
		END) po_status,                      
	get_poh.status_date, get_poh.po_created_date, get_poh.po_approved_date, get_poh.po_issue_date,
	(SELECT /*+ index(un UNIT_PK) */ unit_code FROM m_sys.m_units un WHERE un.unit_id=dummy_poli.qty_unit_id) poli_uom,
	dummy_poli.poli_qty, get_poh.select_code, get_poh.payment_mode,                    
	(SELECT /*+ index(c C_PK) */ company_name FROM m_sys.m_companies c WHERE c.company_id=ms.company_id AND ROWNUM<2) supplier_name,
	ms.sup_code supplier_code,
	(SELECT description FROM m_sys.m_country_nls WHERE cy_id=ms.cy_id AND nls_id=1 AND ROWNUM<2) supplier_location,
	dummy_poli.poli_unit_price unit_price_item,
	ROUND(dummy_poli.poli_qty * dummy_poli.poli_unit_price,2) po_line_item_price,
	(SELECT /*+ index(un UNIT_PK) */ unit_code FROM m_sys.m_units un WHERE un.unit_id=dummy_poli.currency_id  AND ROWNUM<2) currency_po_item,
	NVL(get_poh.discount_percent,0) + NVL(dummy_poli.discount_percent,0) discount_percentage,
	(SELECT /*+ index(frt FRT_PK) */ frt_code FROM m_sys.m_freight_terms frt WHERE frt.frt_id = dummy_poli.frt_id  AND ROWNUM<2) incoterm,
	(SELECT /*+ index(j JOB_PK) */ job_number FROM m_sys.m_jobs j WHERE j.proj_id=r.proj_id AND j.job_id=dummy_poli.job_id  AND ROWNUM<2) account_code_item,
	dummy_poli.freight_value delivery_place,
	rli.attr_group1 Group1,
	rli.attr_group2 Group2,
	rli.attr_group3 Group3,
	rli.attr_group4 Group4,
	rli.attr_group5 Group5,
	ish.prom_contract_date prom_delivery_date,
	(SELECT /*+ index(c CY_PK) */ cy_code FROM m_sys.m_countries c WHERE c.cy_id=dummy_poli.cy_id  AND ROWNUM<2)||' ('||(SELECT /*+ index(cn CYN_PK) */ description FROM m_sys.m_country_nls cn WHERE cn.cy_id=dummy_poli.cy_id AND cn.nls_id=1  AND ROWNUM<2)||')' country_of_origin,
	ROUND(tc.total_price+NVL(tc.tax_amount,0),2) po_total_cost,
	po_currency,  get_poh.get_exchange_rate,
	ish.item_ship_pos, ish.item_ship_sub_pos, poli_unit_price,                    
	NVL(tc.total_price, 0) total_price,
	NVL(tc.tax_amount, 0) tax_amount,
	ish.item_ship_qty, ish.item_ship_id, get_mrr1.mrr_id,  mrr.mrr_number, 
	TO_CHAR(mrr.mrr_create_date, 'DD-MON-YYYY') mrr_creation_date, 
	TO_CHAR(mrr.matl_recv_date, 'DD-MON-YYYY') mrr_recv_date, 
	TO_CHAR(mrr.posted_date, 'DD-MON-YYYY') mrr_posted_date,                      
	(SELECT SUM(recv_qty) FROM m_sys.m_inv_receipts irr WHERE irr.mrr_id=get_mrr1.mrr_id AND irr.item_ship_id=ish.item_ship_id) mrr_quantity,                      
	DECODE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM m_sys.m_item_ships ish1 WHERE ish1.master_ish_id = ish.item_ship_id AND ROWNUM < 2), 1, 'Y', NULL) is_master_tag  
  
FROM -- Real Tables below
  m_sys.m_reqs r ------------------------Table-1 r
  ,(SELECT rr.proj_id, rr.r_id, (SELECT MAX(r1.r_id)  ------------------------Table-2 get_max_r
                        FROM m_sys.m_reqs r1
                        WHERE r1.proj_id = rr.proj_id
                        AND   r1.actual_ind = 'Y'
                        AND   r1.approved_date IS NOT NULL
                        --MZ-1124 AND TRUNC(rel_to_proc_date) <= TO_DATE(:P8103_GET_TO)
                        START WITH r1.r_id = rr.r_id
                        CONNECT BY PRIOR r1.r_id = r1.last_r_id) r_id_max
        FROM m_sys.m_reqs rr
        WHERE 1=1 -- and rr.proj_id = 'D7521'
        AND rr.actual_ind = 'Y'
        AND rr.approved_date IS NOT NULL
    )get_max_r
  ,(SELECT mrli.proj_id, r_id, rli_id, rli_pos, rli_sub_pos           ------------------------Table-3 rli
        , total_release_qty, estimated_ros_date, un.unit_code,attr_group1,attr_group2,attr_group3,attr_group4,attr_group5
        FROM m_sys.m_req_line_items mrli, m_sys.m_units un
        WHERE 1=1 -- and mrli.proj_id = 'D7521'
        AND released_ind   = 'Y'
        AND mrli.release_qty_unit_id = un.unit_id
	 )rli
  ,m_sys.m_po_line_items dummy_poli  ------------------------Table-4 dummy_poli
    ,(SELECT * FROM ------------------------Table-5 get_poli
        (SELECT max_poh.poh_id, max_poh.base_poh_id, poli.poli_id, proj_id
         FROM (
               SELECT MAX(poh1.poh_id) poh_id, poh1.base_poh_id, poh1.proj_id                             
               FROM m_sys.m_po_headers poh1
               WHERE 1=1 -- AND poh1.proj_id = 'D7521'
               --MZ-1124 AND  TRUNC(poh1.po_issue_date) BETWEEN TO_DATE(:P8103_GET_FROM) AND TO_DATE(:P8103_GET_TO)
               AND  TRUNC(poh1.po_issue_date) >= '01-Jan-2024' AND  TRUNC(poh1.po_issue_date)<= '01-Oct-2024'
               GROUP BY base_poh_id, poh1.proj_id
               ) max_poh,
              TABLE(MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_PO_LINE_ITEMS(max_poh.poh_id, 'Y')) poli
        WHERE max_poh.poh_id = poli.poh_id
        ORDER BY poh_id, poli_id
        )
        --MZ-1124 WHERE ((:P8103_FROM_IND = 1 AND ROWNUM < 1001) OR (:P8103_FROM_IND = 0 AND 1=1)) -- restrict records to 1000 when IND = 1
	)get_poli
  ,(SELECT poh.proj_id, poh.poh_id, po_number, po_supp po_rev, sup_id, discount_percent,  ------------------------Table-6 get_poh
        TO_CHAR(poh.creation_date, 'DD-MON-YYYY') po_created_date,
        TO_CHAR(poh.approved_date, 'DD-MON-YYYY') po_approved_date,
        TO_CHAR(poh.po_issue_date, 'DD-MON-YYYY') po_issue_date,
        (SELECT /*+ index(u USR_PK) */ first_name||' '||last_name FROM m_sys.m_users u WHERE u.m_usr_id=poh.buyer AND ROWNUM<2) buyer,
        (SELECT /*+ index(pohn PHN_PK) */ description FROM m_sys.m_po_header_nls pohn WHERE pohn.nls_id=1 AND pohn.poh_id=poh.poh_id AND ROWNUM<2) po_description, 
        MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_EXCHANGE_RATE_USD(poh.proj_id, SYSDATE, poh.currency_id) get_exchange_rate,
        (SELECT /*+ index(un UNIT_PK) */ unit_code FROM m_sys.m_units un WHERE un.unit_id=poh.currency_id AND ROWNUM<2) po_currency,
         (SELECT attr_value
         FROM m_sys.m_used_values uv, m_sys.m_attrs att
         WHERE uv.proj_id    = poh.proj_id
         AND   uv.attr_id    = att.attr_id
         AND   att.attr_code = 'SELECT_CODE'
         AND   uv.pk_id      = poh.poh_id
         AND   uv.used_type  = 'PO'
         AND   ROWNUM < 2) select_code,                     
        (SELECT attr_value
         FROM m_sys.m_used_values uv, m_sys.m_attrs att
         WHERE uv.proj_id    = poh.proj_id
         AND   uv.attr_id    = att.attr_id
         AND   att.attr_code = 'PAYMENT_MODE'
         AND   uv.pk_id      = poh.poh_id
         AND   uv.used_type  = 'PO'
         AND   ROWNUM < 2) payment_mode,
         NVL2(po_close_date, 'CLOSED', NVL2(po_issue_date, 'ISSUED', NVL2(approved_date, 'APPROVED', NVL2(rfa_date, 'FROZEN', 'CONFIRMED')))) get_po_status,
         TO_CHAR(NVL2(po_close_date, po_close_date, NVL2(po_issue_date, po_issue_date, NVL2(approved_date, approved_date, NVL2(rfa_date, rfa_date, lmod)))), 'DD-MON-YYYY') status_date
    FROM m_sys.m_po_headers poh
    WHERE 1=1 --AND poh.proj_id = 'D7521'
      AND  TRUNC(poh.po_issue_date) >= '01-Jan-2024'
      AND   poh.po_issue_date IS NOT NULL
	)get_poh
  ,m_sys.m_idents i                 ------------------------Table-7 idents               
	,m_sys.m_po_total_costs tc        ------------------------Table-8 tc  total_costs
	,m_sys.m_overview_suppliers ms    ------------------------Table-9 ms  overview_suppliers    ------INC1591215 by Vineet  
	--MZ1124 ,m_sys.m_company_addrs mca        ------------------------Table-10 company_addrs mca   not in select / not in use
  ,m_sys.m_item_ships ish           ------------------------Table-11 company_addrs ish  
  ,(SELECT  MAX(mrr.mrr_id) mrr_id, mrr.proj_id, mrr_number, item_ship_id  ------------------------Table-12 get_mrr1
      FROM m_sys.m_matl_recv_rpts mrr, m_sys.m_inv_receipts ir
      WHERE 1=1 -- mrr.proj_id = 'D7521'
        AND   ir.proj_id  = mrr.proj_id
        AND   mrr.mrr_id  = ir.mrr_id
        GROUP BY mrr.proj_id, mrr_number, item_ship_id                 
	)get_mrr1
  ,m_sys.m_matl_recv_rpts mrr       ------------------------Table-13 mrr 

  --- Final WHERE Clause is down 
	WHERE 1=1
  AND  r.proj_id in (select distinct proj_id from m_sys.m_jobs j 
                      where (j.field2 =  '0100' and field1 in ('0923', '0921', '0950'))  or  
                            (j.field2 <> '0100' and substr(field2,1,4) in ('0923', '0921', '0950')))  -- 0923, 0921, 0950
  AND  r.proj_id = get_max_r.proj_id
	AND  r.actual_ind = 'Y'
	AND  get_max_r.r_id_max = r.r_id
  AND  get_max_r.r_id = rli.r_id --AND r.proj_id = rli.proj_id
	AND  rli.rli_id = dummy_poli.rli_id --AND r.proj_id = dummy_poli.proj_id
	AND  dummy_poli.poli_id = get_poli.poli_id
	AND  get_poh.poh_id     = get_poli.poh_id
	AND  i.ident            = dummy_poli.ident --//RN: added to link with ident  
	AND  get_poh.poh_id     = tc.poh_id(+)
	AND  get_poh.sup_id     = ms.sup_id
  AND  get_poli.poli_id   = ish.poli_id(+) --//RN: change to left join to get record without itemshipment  
  AND  ish.proj_id        = r.proj_id
	AND  ish.item_ship_id   = get_mrr1.item_ship_id(+)
	AND  get_mrr1.mrr_id     = mrr.mrr_id(+)
 )  
ORDER BY project_id , po_number, poli_pos, poli_sub_pos

oracleReaderQuery.value:
SELECT
DISTINCT poh.poh_id
  ,poh.proj_id PROJECT_NR
  ,prj.description PROJECT_DESCRIPTION
  ,poh.po_number                           
  ,replace(pohn.description,'|', ' ') DESCRIPTION
  ,SUP.company_name    SUPPLIER                         
  ,CY.cy_code SUPPLIER_COUNTRY
  ,poh.expediter
  ,am.order_seq
  ,c.mc_code
  ,AM.planned_start_date   
  ,AM.planned_end_date
  ,AM.start_date forecasted_start_date
  ,AM.end_date forecasted_end_date
  ,AM.actual_start_date
  ,AM.actual_end_date
  ,AM.actual_progress
  ,TO_CHAR(max(AM.lmod),'DD-MON-YYYY') lmod           
  ,AM.weight_factor weight_factor
  ,poh.tot_matl_cost order_total
  ,u.unit_code currency
FROM
   m_sys.m_po_headers POH
  ,m_sys.m_po_header_nls  pohn
  ,M_SYS.M_REQ_TO_POS RP
  ,M_SYS.M_ATT_MILESTONES am
  ,M_SYS.m_ms_configs c 
  ,M_SYS.m_projects prj,m_sys.m_disciplines dp
  ,m_sys.m_reqs r
  ,m_sys.m_overview_suppliers sup 
  ,m_units u
  ,m_countries   cy
  ,m_sys.m_country_nls cyn
WHERE 1=1
    and poh.sup_id  = sup.sup_id
    and u.unit_id  = poh.currency_id
    and pohn.poh_id(+) = poh.poh_id    
    and poh.poh_id = RP.BASE_POH_ID  
    and RP.PROJ_ID = am.proj_id 
    and AM.PK_ID(+) = POH.POH_ID--RP.RP_ID 
    and c.mc_id(+) = am.mc_id 
    and (am.PK_TYPE(+) = 'POH' or am.PK_TYPE(+) = 'PO')
    and prj.proj_id = poh.proj_id 
    and r.dp_id = dp.dp_id   
    and rp.r_id = r.r_id
    and sup.cy_id = cy.cy_id(+)
    and cy.cy_id = cyn.cy_id(+)
    and cyn.nls_id(+) = 1
    and poh.proj_id = '@{pipeline().parameters.proj_id}'
   group by poh.poh_ID,
       poh.proj_id, 
       prj.description, 
       --MZ dp.dp_code ,  
       poh.po_number     ,  
       pohn.description  ,
       SUP.company_name  ,  
       CY.cy_code    , 
       poh.expediter,   
       am.order_seq       ,  
       c.mc_code         ,  
       AM.start_date, 
       AM.end_date,
       AM.actual_start_date, 
       AM.actual_end_date,
       AM.actual_progress,
       AM.weight_factor  ,                      
       AM.planned_start_date     ,     
       AM.planned_end_date       ,    
       poh.tot_matl_cost , 
       u.unit_code 
    order by poh.po_number, am.order_seq

sqlReaderQuery.value:
@concat('WITH Planned AS (
SELECT pi.ID AS ProgressItemID
  , ISNULL(sum(hours * rocs.Percentage)/100, 0) AS PIPlannedHours							
  FROM dbo.PM_ProgressItem AS pi WITH (NOLOCK)
    LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.SP_ProgressItem_CWP  AS  picwp  WITH (NOLOCK) 
	ON pi.id = picwp.ProgressItemID
    INNER JOIN dbo.PM_ROCS AS rocs WITH (NOLOCK)	
	ON rocs.ID = picwp.ROCSID
    WHERE picwp.IsPlanned = 1
    GROUP BY pi.id 
)
, RocsSteps AS (
SELECT ROCID
	, COUNT(ID) AS TotalSteps
  FROM dbo.PM_ROCS WITH (NOLOCK)
    GROUP BY ROCID
)
, Planning AS (
SELECT ProgressItemID
	, picwp.ROCID 
	,  sum(CAST( IsPlanned AS int)) PlannedSteps
	, TotalSteps
  FROM dbo.SP_ProgressItem_CWP picwp WITH (NOLOCK)
    INNER JOIN RocsSteps rs WITH (NOLOCK)	
	ON rs.ROCID = picwp.ROCID
    GROUP BY ProgressItemID
	, picwp.ROCID
	, TotalSteps
)
, Progressed AS (
SELECT picwp.ProgressItemID
	, isnull(sum(ph.ProgressDelta),0) AS SumProgress
  FROM dbo.SP_ProgressHistory ph WITH (NOLOCK)
    INNER JOIN dbo.SP_ProgressItem_CWP picwp WITH (NOLOCK) 	
	ON ph.ProgressItemCWPID = picwp.ID
    GROUP BY  picwp.ProgressItemID
)

, ProgressStatus AS (	
SELECT pi.ID AS paprsID
	,COUNT( Distinct picwp.cwpid) AS WorkPackCount
	,CASE	WHEN SumProgress / TotalSteps = 100
			THEN','''', 'Fully Progressed','''','
		WHEN SumProgress = 0 OR SumProgress IS null
			THEN ','''','Not Progressed','''','
		ELSE ','''','Partially Progressed','''','
		END AS ProgressStatus
	,CASE WHEN plannedSteps = 0 
			THEN ','''','Not Planned','''','
		WHEN plannedSteps < TotalSteps 
			THEN ','''','Partially Planned','''','
		ELSE	','''','Fully Planned','''','
		END AS PlannedStatus
  FROM dbo.PM_ProgressItem AS pi WITH (NOLOCK)
    INNER JOIN dbo.SP_ProgressItem_CWP picwp WITH (NOLOCK)	
	ON pi.ID = picwp.ProgressItemID
    LEFT JOIN Planning pl WITH (NOLOCK)	
	ON pl.ProgressItemID = pi.id
    LEFT JOIN Progressed AS prog WITH (NOLOCK)	
	ON pi.ID = prog.ProgressItemID
    GROUP BY pi.ID
		, plannedSteps
		, TotalSteps
		, SumProgress
)',
'SELECT ',
    pipeline().parameters.p_pl_projectid,' Project_id, ',
	'''',activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.function_code,'''',' function_code '
	,',','''',activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.source_name,'''',' source_name '
	,',','''',activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.sub_source_name,'''',' sub_source_name'
	,',','''',activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.class_name_hours,'''',' class_name_hours '
	,',','''',activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.class_name_quantity,'''',' class_name_quantity '
	,',','''',activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.sub_class_hours,'''',' sub_class_hours '
	,',','''',activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.sub_class_qty,'''',' sub_class_qty '
	,',','''',activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.sub_class_plan,'''',' sub_class_plan '
	,',','''',activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.unit_of_measure_hours,'''',' unit_of_measure_hours '
	,',','''',activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.unit_of_measure_qty,'''',' unit_of_measure_qty '
	,',','pi.PMID pim_code
	,r.Code roc_code
	,rs.Step ROC_Step
	,ph.Code Phase_Code
	,wa.Code WorkArea_Code
	,act.ScheduleUnit AS WorkUnit_Code
	,sr.Code ScheduleResource_Code
	,act.CWP cwp_code
	,act.Activity
	,cwp.Name iwp_Code
	,pi.Contract 
	,pi.CostCode
	,replace(replace(replace(pi.CostCodeDescription,char(10),','''',' ','''','),char(34),','''',' ','''','),char(13),','''',' ','''',') costcode_desription
	,pi.CostType
	,pi.CostingCOA	
	,replace(replace(replace(pi.Description,char(10),','''',' ','''','),char(34),','''',' ','''','),char(13),','''',' ','''',') Description
	,convert(date,getdate()) budget_date
	,replace(replace(replace(pi.DrawingNo,char(10),','''',' ','''','),char(34),','''',' ','''','),char(13),','''',' ','''',') DrawingNo
	,replace(replace(replace(pi.TagNo,char(10),','''',' ','''','),char(34),','''',' ','''','),char(13),','''',' ','''',') TagNo
	,replace(replace(replace(pi.Spool,char(10),','''',' ','''','),char(34),','''',' ','''','),char(13),','''',' ','''',') Spool
	,replace(replace(replace(pi.Line,char(10),','''',' ','''','),char(34),','''',' ','''','),char(13),','''',' ','''',') Line
	,replace(replace(replace(pi.spec,char(10),','''',' ','''','),char(34),','''',' ','''','),char(13),','''',' ','''',') spec
	,pi.System
	,replace(replace(replace(pi.PieceMark,char(10),','''',' ','''','),char(34),','''',' ','''','),char(13),','''',' ','''',') PieceMark
	,replace(replace(replace(pi.NumberOfPieces,char(10),','''',' ','''','),char(34),','''',' ','''','),char(13),','''',' ','''',') NumberOfPieces
	,pi.Subsystem
	,replace(replace(replace(pi.text5,char(10),','''',' ','''','),char(34),','''',' ','''','),char(13),','''',' ','''',') text5
	,replace(replace(replace(pi.Level6,char(10),','''',' ','''','),char(34),','''',' ','''','),char(13),','''',' ','''',') Level6
	,isnull(PlannedStatus, ','''','Not Planned','''',') AS PlannedStatus
	,isnull(ProgressStatus, ','''','Not Progressed','''',') AS ProgressStatus
	,sum(pi.Hours * rs.Percentage * .01) budgethours
	,sum(pi.Quantity * rs.Percentage *.01) BudgetQuantity
	,sum(ISNULL(p.PIPlannedHours, 0)*rs.Percentage*.01) AS PlannedHours
  FROM dbo.PM_ProgressItem pi WITH (NOLOCK)
    LEFT JOIN dbo.PM_Activity act  WITH (NOLOCK) 
	ON pi.ActivityID = act.ID		
    LEFT JOIN dbo.PM_ROC r WITH (NOLOCK)	
	ON pi.ROCID = r.ID
    LEFT JOIN dbo.PM_ROCS rs WITH (NOLOCK)
	ON rs.ROCID = pi.ROCID
	LEFT JOIN [dbo].[PM_ProjectMasterData] pr with (NOLOCK) ON pr.Project <> ','''','ssssss','''','
	LEFT JOIN Planned p WITH (NOLOCK)	
	ON pi.ID = p.ProgressItemID
    LEFT JOIN ProgressStatus ProgStat WITH (NOLOCK) 	
	ON pi.ID = progstat.paprsID
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SP_ProgressItem_CWP picwp WITH (NOLOCK) 	
	ON pi.ID = picwp.ProgressItemID AND rs.ROCID = picwp.ROCID AND rs.ID = picwp.ROCSID
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SP_ConstructionWorkPack cwp WITH (NOLOCK)  
	ON cwp.ID = picwp.CWPID
	LEFT JOIN [dbo].[SP_WorkArea] wa with (NOLOCK) ON act.ScheduleWorkArea = wa.Code
	LEFT JOIN [dbo].[SP_Phases] ph with (NOLOCK) ON wa.PhaseID = ph.ID
	LEFT JOIN [dbo].[SP_ScheduleResource] sr with (NOLOCK) ON cwp.ScheduleResourceID = sr.ID
    WHERE picwp.IsPlanned = 1
group by     ','''','99','''',' + ltrim(rtrim(pr.Project))
	,pi.PMID  
	,r.Code
    ,rs.Step  
	,ph.Code 
	,wa.Code
	,act.ScheduleUnit
	,sr.Code
	,act.CWP
	,act.Activity
	,cwp.Name
	,pi.Contract 
	,pi.CostCode
	,pi.CostCodeDescription
	,pi.CostType
	,pi.CostingCOA	
	,pi.Description
	,pi.DrawingNo
	,pi.TagNo
	,pi.Spool
	,pi.Line
	,pi.spec
	,pi.System
	,pi.PieceMark
	,pi.NumberOfPieces
	,pi.Subsystem
	,pi.text5
	,pi.Level6
	,isnull(PlannedStatus, ','''','Not Planned','''',')
	,isnull(ProgressStatus, ','''','Not Progressed','''',')')

SELECT DISTINCT
  project_id, requisition_no, req_rev, req_originator, req_date, released_to_proc, proc_ack_date,
  DECODE(attr_char3,
    'PROJECT', mdr_pack_number,
    'MRO', mg_lookup_code,
    DECODE(mdr_pack_number, '-', mg_lookup_code, mdr_pack_number)
  ) matl_wrk_grp,
  DECODE(attr_char3,
    'PROJECT', mg_nls_proj_desc,
    'MRO', mg_nls_mro_desc,
    DECODE(mdr_pack_number, '-', mg_nls_mro_desc, mg_nls_proj_desc)
  ) matl_wrk_nls,
  rli_pos, rli_sub_pos, released_qty, uom, ros_date, po_number, po_rev, po_description, po_status, status_date,
  po_created_date, po_issue_date, po_approved_date,
  supplier_code, supplier_name, supplier_location, country_of_origin,
  buyer, select_code, payment_mode, commodity_code, ident_code, item_desc,
  poli_pos, poli_sub_pos, account_code_item, poli_uom, poli_qty,
  CAST(unit_price_item AS NUMBER(30,10)) unit_price_item,
  CAST(po_line_item_price AS NUMBER(30,10)) po_line_item_price,
  CAST(ROUND(get_exchange_rate * (poli_qty * poli_unit_price), 2) AS NUMBER(30,10)) po_line_item_price_usd,
  CAST(po_total_cost AS NUMBER(30,10)) po_total_cost,
  CAST(ROUND(get_exchange_rate * (total_price + tax_amount), 2) AS NUMBER(30,10)) po_total_usd,
  po_currency, currency_po_item,
  CAST(discount_percentage AS NUMBER(30,10)) discount_percentage,
  incoterm, delivery_place, Group1, Group2, Group3, Group4, Group5, prom_delivery_date,
  mrr_number, mrr_creation_date, mrr_recv_date, mrr_posted_date, CAST(mrr_quantity AS NUMBER(30,10)) mrr_quantity, is_master_tag
FROM (
  SELECT
    get_poh.proj_id project_id,
    r.r_code requisition_no,
    r.r_supp req_rev,
    dummy_poli.poli_id,
    TO_CHAR(r.created_date, 'DD-MON-YYYY') req_date,
    usr_originator.full_name req_originator,
    TO_CHAR(r.rel_to_proc_date, 'DD-MON-YYYY') released_to_proc,
    TO_CHAR(r.proc_acknowledge_date, 'DD-MON-YYYY') proc_ack_date,
    r.mg_id get_mg_id,
    uv_mdr.attr_value mdr_pack_number,
    rli.rli_pos,
    rli.rli_sub_pos,
    cc.commodity_code,
    i.ident_code,
    i.ident,
    REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(LTRIM(MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM_bir.GET_IDENT_DESC_WITH_DEVIATION(i.ident, dummy_poli.poli_id, 'POLI'), '-'), '^-' || ' ?', ''), CHR(13), ' '), CHR(10), ' '), '- ', '') item_desc,
    rli.total_release_qty released_qty,
    rli.unit_code uom,
    TO_CHAR(rli.estimated_ros_date, 'DD-MON-YYYY') ros_date,
    get_poh.poh_id,
    usr_buyer.full_name buyer,
    get_poh.po_number,
    get_poh.po_rev,
    pohn.description po_description,
    dummy_poli.poli_pos,
    dummy_poli.poli_sub_pos,
    (CASE
      WHEN (NVL(tc.total_price, 0) + NVL(dummy_poli.poli_qty, 0) = 0) THEN
        DECODE((SUM(dummy_poli.poli_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY get_poh.poh_id, dummy_poli.poli_id)), 0, 'CANCELLED', get_poh.get_po_status)
      ELSE
        get_poh.get_po_status
    END) po_status,
    get_poh.status_date,
    get_poh.po_created_date,
    get_poh.po_approved_date,
    get_poh.po_issue_date,
    unit_qty.unit_code poli_uom,
    dummy_poli.poli_qty poli_qty,
    uv_select.attr_value select_code,
    uv_payment.attr_value payment_mode,
    sup.company_name supplier_name,
    ms.sup_code supplier_code,
    country_nls.description supplier_location,
    dummy_poli.poli_unit_price unit_price_item,
    ROUND(dummy_poli.poli_qty * dummy_poli.poli_unit_price, 2) po_line_item_price,
    unit_curr.unit_code currency_po_item,
    NVL(get_poh.discount_percent, 0) + NVL(dummy_poli.discount_percent, 0) discount_percentage,
    frt.frt_code incoterm,
    job.job_number account_code_item,
    dummy_poli.freight_value delivery_place,
    rli.attr_group1 Group1,
    rli.attr_group2 Group2,
    rli.attr_group3 Group3,
    rli.attr_group4 Group4,
    rli.attr_group5 Group5,
    proj_attr.attr_char3 attr_char3,
    mg_lookup.mg_code mg_lookup_code,
    mg_nls_mro.description mg_nls_mro_desc,
    mg_nls_proj.description mg_nls_proj_desc,
    ish.prom_contract_date prom_delivery_date,
    cy.cy_code || ' (' || cyn.description || ')' country_of_origin,
    ROUND(tc.total_price + NVL(tc.tax_amount, 0), 2) po_total_cost,
    unit_poh_curr.unit_code po_currency,
    get_poh.get_exchange_rate,
    ish.item_ship_pos,
    ish.item_ship_sub_pos,
    dummy_poli.poli_unit_price poli_unit_price,
    NVL(tc.total_price, 0) total_price,
    NVL(tc.tax_amount, 0) tax_amount,
    ish.item_ship_qty,
    ish.item_ship_id,
    get_mrr1.mrr_id,
    mrr.mrr_number,
    TO_CHAR(mrr.mrr_create_date, 'DD-MON-YYYY') mrr_creation_date,
    TO_CHAR(mrr.matl_recv_date, 'DD-MON-YYYY') mrr_recv_date,
    TO_CHAR(mrr.posted_date, 'DD-MON-YYYY') mrr_posted_date,
    irr_sum.mrr_quantity,
    DECODE(ish_master.cnt, 1, 'Y', NULL) is_master_tag,
    get_poh.proj_id proj_id_for_lookup,
    r.r_id r_id_for_lookup
  FROM m_sys.m_reqs r
  -- Get max r_id using hierarchical query (filtered by proj_id early)
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT
      rr.proj_id,
      rr.r_id,
      (SELECT MAX(r1.r_id)
       FROM m_sys.m_reqs r1
       WHERE r1.proj_id = rr.proj_id
         AND r1.actual_ind = 'Y'
         AND r1.approved_date IS NOT NULL
       START WITH r1.r_id = rr.r_id
       CONNECT BY PRIOR r1.r_id = r1.last_r_id) r_id_max
    FROM m_sys.m_reqs rr
    WHERE rr.actual_ind = 'Y'
      AND rr.approved_date IS NOT NULL
      AND rr.proj_id = '@{item()}'
  ) get_max_r ON r.proj_id = get_max_r.proj_id
    AND r.actual_ind = 'Y'
    AND get_max_r.r_id_max = r.r_id
    AND r.proj_id = '@{item()}'
  -- Requirement line items
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT
      mrli.proj_id,
      r_id,
      rli_id,
      rli_pos,
      rli_sub_pos,
      total_release_qty,
      estimated_ros_date,
      un.unit_code,
      attr_group1,
      attr_group2,
      attr_group3,
      attr_group4,
      attr_group5
    FROM m_sys.m_req_line_items mrli
    INNER JOIN m_sys.m_units un ON mrli.release_qty_unit_id = un.unit_id
    WHERE mrli.released_ind = 'Y'
  ) rli ON get_max_r.r_id = rli.r_id
  -- PO line items
  INNER JOIN m_sys.m_po_line_items dummy_poli ON rli.rli_id = dummy_poli.rli_id
  -- Get PO line items with max POH (date filters applied early for performance)
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT
      max_poh.poh_id,
      max_poh.base_poh_id,
      poli.poli_id,
      max_poh.proj_id
    FROM (
      SELECT
        MAX(poh1.poh_id) poh_id,
        poh1.base_poh_id,
        poh1.proj_id
      FROM m_sys.m_po_headers poh1
      WHERE poh1.po_issue_date IS NOT NULL
        AND TRUNC(poh1.po_issue_date) >= '01-Jan-2024'
      GROUP BY poh1.base_poh_id, poh1.proj_id
    ) max_poh,
    TABLE(MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_PO_LINE_ITEMS(max_poh.poh_id, 'Y')) poli
    WHERE max_poh.poh_id = poli.poh_id
  ) get_poli ON dummy_poli.poli_id = get_poli.poli_id
  -- PO headers with date filters applied early
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT
      poh.proj_id,
      poh.poh_id,
      po_number,
      po_supp po_rev,
      sup_id,
      discount_percent,
      TO_CHAR(poh.creation_date, 'DD-MON-YYYY') po_created_date,
      TO_CHAR(poh.approved_date, 'DD-MON-YYYY') po_approved_date,
      TO_CHAR(poh.po_issue_date, 'DD-MON-YYYY') po_issue_date,
      MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_EXCHANGE_RATE_USD(poh.proj_id, SYSDATE, poh.currency_id) get_exchange_rate,
      NVL2(po_close_date, 'CLOSED', NVL2(po_issue_date, 'ISSUED', NVL2(approved_date, 'APPROVED', NVL2(rfa_date, 'FROZEN', 'CONFIRMED')))) get_po_status,
      TO_CHAR(NVL2(po_close_date, po_close_date, NVL2(po_issue_date, po_issue_date, NVL2(approved_date, approved_date, NVL2(rfa_date, rfa_date, lmod)))), 'DD-MON-YYYY') status_date,
      poh.currency_id,
      poh.buyer buyer_id
    FROM m_sys.m_po_headers poh
    WHERE poh.po_issue_date IS NOT NULL
      AND TRUNC(poh.po_issue_date) >= '01-Jan-2024'
  ) get_poh ON get_poh.poh_id = get_poli.poh_id
  -- Identifications
  INNER JOIN m_sys.m_idents i ON i.ident = dummy_poli.ident
  -- Total costs (LEFT JOIN as it may not exist)
  LEFT JOIN m_sys.m_po_total_costs tc ON get_poh.poh_id = tc.poh_id
  -- Suppliers
  INNER JOIN m_sys.m_overview_suppliers ms ON get_poh.sup_id = ms.sup_id
  -- Item shipments (LEFT JOIN as it may not exist)
  LEFT JOIN m_sys.m_item_ships ish ON get_poli.poli_id = ish.poli_id AND ish.proj_id = r.proj_id
  -- MRR aggregation
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      MAX(mrr.mrr_id) mrr_id,
      mrr.proj_id,
      mrr.mrr_number,
      item_ship_id
    FROM m_sys.m_matl_recv_rpts mrr
    INNER JOIN m_sys.m_inv_receipts ir ON mrr.proj_id = ir.proj_id AND mrr.mrr_id = ir.mrr_id
    GROUP BY mrr.proj_id, mrr.mrr_number, item_ship_id
  ) get_mrr1 ON ish.item_ship_id = get_mrr1.item_ship_id
  -- Material Receipt Reports
  LEFT JOIN m_sys.m_matl_recv_rpts mrr ON get_mrr1.mrr_id = mrr.mrr_id
  -- Lookup tables optimized with LEFT JOINs (removed correlated subqueries)
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT /*+ index(u USR_PK) */
      m_usr_id,
      first_name || ' ' || last_name full_name
    FROM m_sys.m_users u
  ) usr_originator ON usr_originator.m_usr_id = r.originator
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT /*+ index(un UNIT_PK) */
      unit_id,
      unit_code
    FROM m_sys.m_units
  ) unit_qty ON unit_qty.unit_id = dummy_poli.qty_unit_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT /*+ index(un UNIT_PK) */
      unit_id,
      unit_code
    FROM m_sys.m_units
  ) unit_curr ON unit_curr.unit_id = dummy_poli.currency_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT /*+ index(c C_PK) */
      company_id,
      company_name
    FROM m_sys.m_companies
  ) sup ON sup.company_id = ms.company_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT /*+ index(frt FRT_PK) */
      frt_id,
      frt_code
    FROM m_sys.m_freight_terms
  ) frt ON frt.frt_id = dummy_poli.frt_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT /*+ index(cc CC_PK) */
      commodity_id,
      commodity_code
    FROM m_sys.m_commodity_codes
  ) cc ON cc.commodity_id = i.commodity_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT /*+ index(j JOB_PK) */
      proj_id,
      job_id,
      job_number
    FROM m_sys.m_jobs
  ) job ON job.proj_id = r.proj_id AND job.job_id = dummy_poli.job_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT /*+ index(c CY_PK) */
      cy_id,
      cy_code
    FROM m_sys.m_countries
  ) cy ON cy.cy_id = dummy_poli.cy_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT /*+ index(cn CYN_PK) */
      cy_id,
      description
    FROM m_sys.m_country_nls
    WHERE nls_id = 1
  ) cyn ON cyn.cy_id = dummy_poli.cy_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      cy_id,
      description
    FROM m_sys.m_country_nls
    WHERE nls_id = 1
  ) country_nls ON country_nls.cy_id = ms.cy_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT /*+ index(un UNIT_PK) */
      unit_id,
      unit_code
    FROM m_sys.m_units
  ) unit_poh_curr ON unit_poh_curr.unit_id = get_poh.currency_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT /*+ index(u USR_PK) */
      m_usr_id,
      first_name || ' ' || last_name full_name
    FROM m_sys.m_users
  ) usr_buyer ON usr_buyer.m_usr_id = get_poh.buyer_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT /*+ index(pohn PHN_PK) */
      poh_id,
      description
    FROM m_sys.m_po_header_nls
    WHERE nls_id = 1
  ) pohn ON pohn.poh_id = get_poh.poh_id
  -- MDR Package Number attribute (used_type = 'ER')
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      uv.proj_id,
      uv.pk_id,
      uv.attr_value
    FROM m_sys.m_used_values uv
    INNER JOIN m_sys.m_attrs att ON uv.attr_id = att.attr_id
    WHERE att.attr_code = 'MDR_PACKAGE_NUMBER'
      AND uv.used_type = 'ER'
  ) uv_mdr ON uv_mdr.proj_id = get_poh.proj_id
    AND uv_mdr.pk_id = r.r_id
  -- SELECT_CODE attribute (used_type = 'PO')
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      uv.proj_id,
      uv.pk_id,
      uv.attr_value
    FROM m_sys.m_used_values uv
    INNER JOIN m_sys.m_attrs att ON uv.attr_id = att.attr_id
    WHERE att.attr_code = 'SELECT_CODE'
      AND uv.used_type = 'PO'
  ) uv_select ON uv_select.proj_id = get_poh.proj_id
    AND uv_select.pk_id = get_poh.poh_id
  -- PAYMENT_MODE attribute (used_type = 'PO')
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      uv.proj_id,
      uv.pk_id,
      uv.attr_value
    FROM m_sys.m_used_values uv
    INNER JOIN m_sys.m_attrs att ON uv.attr_id = att.attr_id
    WHERE att.attr_code = 'PAYMENT_MODE'
      AND uv.used_type = 'PO'
  ) uv_payment ON uv_payment.proj_id = get_poh.proj_id
    AND uv_payment.pk_id = get_poh.poh_id
  -- MRR quantity aggregation
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      mrr_id,
      item_ship_id,
      SUM(recv_qty) mrr_quantity
    FROM m_sys.m_inv_receipts
    GROUP BY mrr_id, item_ship_id
  ) irr_sum ON irr_sum.mrr_id = get_mrr1.mrr_id
    AND irr_sum.item_ship_id = ish.item_ship_id
  -- Master tag check
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      master_ish_id,
      COUNT(1) cnt
    FROM m_sys.m_item_ships
    GROUP BY master_ish_id
    HAVING COUNT(1) = 1
  ) ish_master ON ish_master.master_ish_id = ish.item_ship_id
  -- Project attribute lookup (for attr_char3)
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      proj_id,
      NVL(attr_char3, 'NOTAVAILABLE') attr_char3
    FROM m_sys.m_projects
  ) proj_attr ON proj_attr.proj_id = get_poh.proj_id
  -- Material group lookup for MRO (using r.mg_id)
  LEFT JOIN m_sys.m_material_groups mg_lookup ON mg_lookup.mg_id = r.mg_id
  -- Material group NLS for MRO
  LEFT JOIN m_sys.m_material_group_nls mg_nls_mro ON mg_nls_mro.mg_id = r.mg_id
    AND mg_nls_mro.nls_id = 1
  -- Material group lookup for PROJECT (via mdr_pack_number = mg_code)
  LEFT JOIN m_sys.m_material_groups mg_proj ON mg_proj.mg_code = uv_mdr.attr_value
  LEFT JOIN m_sys.m_material_group_nls mg_nls_proj ON mg_nls_proj.mg_id = mg_proj.mg_id
    AND mg_nls_proj.nls_id = 1
)
ORDER BY project_id, po_number, poli_pos, poli_sub_pos

text.value:
@concat('INSERT INTO [dbo].[ADFExtFileLogs]  ([PipelineName]  ,[RunId]  ,[ExternalFilename]  ,[VersionNo]  ,[Archive_location]  ,[Uploaded_by]  ,[SourceRecords]  ,[CreatedDateTime]) ',
' SELECT ''',pipeline().Pipeline,''' as PipelineName, ''',pipeline().RunId,''' as RunId, ''',item().name,''' as SrcFileName,'''

--Update the dim_ent_document_mileston_sequence table with latest conversion values for data_lake_standard_milestone_name

  UPDATE t1
  SET t1.[data_lake_standard_milestone_name] = t2.[data_lake_standard_milestone_name]
  FROM [dbo].[dim_ent_document_milestone_sequence] AS t1
  INNER JOIN [gpd].[NCSA_datalake_milestone_seq] AS t2
  ON t1.[milestone_gate_name] = t2.[milestone_gate_name]
  WHERE t1.active = 1;

insert into [rpy].[Exchange_Rates_Data]
(ATTRIBUTE1,ATTRIBUTE10,ATTRIBUTE11,ATTRIBUTE12,ATTRIBUTE13,ATTRIBUTE14,ATTRIBUTE15,ATTRIBUTE2,ATTRIBUTE3,ATTRIBUTE4,ATTRIBUTE5,ATTRIBUTE6,ATTRIBUTE7,ATTRIBUTE8,ATTRIBUTE9,ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY,ATTRIBUTE_DATE1,ATTRIBUTE_DATE2,ATTRIBUTE_DATE3,ATTRIBUTE_DATE4,ATTRIBUTE_DATE5,ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER1,ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER2,ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER3,ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER4,ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER5,CONVERSION_DATE
,CONVERSION_RATE,CONVERSION_TYPE,CREATED_BY,CREATION_DATE,ENTERPRISE_ID,FROM_CURRENCY,LAST_UPDATED_BY,LAST_UPDATE_DATE,LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN,OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER,RATE_SOURCE_CODE,STATUS_CODE
,TO_CURRENCY,source_name,sub_source_name,created_date_time)
select
a.ATTRIBUTE1,a.ATTRIBUTE10,a.ATTRIBUTE11,a.ATTRIBUTE12,a.ATTRIBUTE13,a.ATTRIBUTE14,a.ATTRIBUTE15,a.ATTRIBUTE2,a.ATTRIBUTE3,a.ATTRIBUTE4,a.ATTRIBUTE5,a.ATTRIBUTE6,a.ATTRIBUTE7,a.ATTRIBUTE8,a.ATTRIBUTE9,a.ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY,a.ATTRIBUTE_DATE1,a.ATTRIBUTE_DATE2,a.ATTRIBUTE_DATE3,a.ATTRIBUTE_DATE4,a.ATTRIBUTE_DATE5,a.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER1,a.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER2,a.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER3,a.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER4,a.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER5,a.CONVERSION_DATE,a.CONVERSION_RATE,a.CONVERSION_TYPE,a.CREATED_BY,a.CREATION_DATE,a.ENTERPRISE_ID,a.FROM_CURRENCY,a.LAST_UPDATED_BY,a.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,a.LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN,a.OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER,a.RATE_SOURCE_CODE,a.STATUS_CODE,a.TO_CURRENCY,a.source_name,a.sub_source_name,a.created_date_time
from [rpy].[Exchange_Rates_Data_stage] a,
(select FROM_CURRENCY, TO_CURRENCY, CONVERSION_DATE, CONVERSION_TYPE, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, max(ID) as ID 
from [rpy].[Exchange_Rates_Data_stage]
group by FROM_CURRENCY, TO_CURRENCY, CONVERSION_DATE, CONVERSION_TYPE, LAST_UPDATE_DATE) b
where a.FROM_CURRENCY = b.FROM_CURRENCY
and a.TO_CURRENCY = b.TO_CURRENCY
and a.CONVERSION_DATE = b.CONVERSION_DATE
and a.CONVERSION_TYPE = b.CONVERSION_TYPE
and a.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = b.LAST_UPDATE_DATE

scripts.text:
update [gpd].[NCSA_PLM_Inboxtask]
set discipline= c.[discipline_code]
from [gpd].[NCSA_PLM_Inboxtask] a 
left join dbo.dim_entp_eng_deliverables b on a.document_id=b.document_id
inner join [dbo].[dim_ent_discipline] c on c.[dim_ent_discipline_nk]=b.[dim_ent_discipline_nk]
where b.active=1 and c.active=1

update [gpd].[NCSA_PLM_Inboxtask]
set discipline= c.[discipline_code]
from [gpd].[NCSA_PLM_Inboxtask] a 
left join dbo.dim_entp_ven_deliverables b on a.document_id=b.document_id

oracleReaderQuery.value:
select 
a.*
,b.TYPE as Person_Type
,b.FIRSTNAME
,b.LASTNAME
,p.PROJECT_NUMBER as project_number

,(CASE WHEN r.IDOCSENGDOC_ID = ed.ID THEN ed.MDR_IDOCSDOCID
     WHEN r.IDOCSVENDORDOC_ID = vd.ID THEN vd.MDR_IDOCSDOCID
	 ELSE NULL
	 END ) AS MDR_IDOCSDOCID


from PLMDATA.PLM_DT_INBOXTASK a
left join PLMDATA.PLM_DT_PERSON b on a.OWNER=b.NAME
left join PLMDATA.PLM_DT_ROUTE r on a.ROUTE_ID=r.ID
left join PLMDATA.PLM_DT_IDOCS_ENG_DOCUMENT ed on r.IDOCSENGDOC_ID = ed.ID
left join PLMDATA.PLM_DT_IDOCS_VENDOR_DOCUMENT vd on r.IDOCSVENDORDOC_ID = vd.ID
left join PLMDATA.PLM_DT_PROJECT p on p.PROJECT_NAME=a.PROJECT

isnull((select code from SP_ScheduleResource where ID = ScheduleResourceID),'')   ScheduleResourceID,
	isnull(convert(varchar(15),[ID]),'')  ID,
	isnull(convert(varchar(15),[ActivityID]),'') ActivityID ,
	isnull((select code from  SP_ScheduleResource where ID = ScheduleResourceId),'') Schedule_Resource_Code ,
	isnull([Name],'') Name,
	isnull(convert(varchar(10),[ScheduleOffset]),'') ScheduleOffset ,
	isnull(convert(varchar(15),[ScheduleDuration]),'') ScheduleDuration ,
	isnull(convert(varchar(15),[ROCID]),'') ROCID ,
	isnull([CostCode],'') CostCode ,
	isnull([UOM],'') UOM ,
	isnull(replace (replace (replace(replace (replace([Description] , char(10), ''),char(13),'') , ',', ''), '"',''),'“',''),'') AS Description,
	isnull(convert(varchar(15),[PeriodID]),'') PeriodID ,
	isnull(convert(varchar(15),[ForemanID]),'') ForemanID,
	isnull(replace(replace(notes, CHAR(13),''), CHAR(10),''),'') as Notes,
	isnull(convert(varchar(15),[Priority]),'') Priority ,
	isnull(convert(varchar(15),[PeriodPriority]),'') PeriodPriority ,
	isnull(convert(varchar(15),[IssuedByID]),'') IssuedByID ,
	isnull(convert(varchar(30),[IssuedDate]),'') IssuedDate ,
	isnull(convert(varchar(15),[ExportedByID]),'') ExportedByID ,
	isnull(convert(varchar(30),[ExportedDate]),'') ExportedDate ,
	isnull(convert(varchar(15),[CreatedByID]),'') CreatedByID ,
	isnull(convert(varchar(30),[CreatedDate]),'') CreatedDate ,
	isnull(convert(varchar(15),[ModifiedByID]),'') ModifiedByID ,
	isnull(convert(varchar(30),[ModifiedDate]),'') ModifiedDate ,
	isnull(convert(varchar(15),[ParentID]),'') ParentID ,
	isnull(convert(varchar(15),[DurationInDays]),'') DurationInDays ,
	isnull(convert(varchar(30),[CWPStartDate]),'') CWPStartDate,
	isnull(convert(varchar(30),[CWPEndDate]),'') CWPEndDate ,
	isnull(convert(varchar(15),[PrelimDurationInHours]),'') PrelimDurationInHours ,
	isnull(convert(varchar(15),[DurationInWorkDays]),'') DurationInWorkDays ,
	isnull(convert(varchar(15),[MatlPercAllocated]),'') MatlPercAllocated ,
	isnull(convert(varchar(30),[RestartDate]),'') RestartDate ,
	isnull(convert(varchar(15),[RemainingDuration]),'') RemainingDuration ,
	isnull(convert(varchar(30),[ModifiedStartDate]),'') ModifiedStartDate ,
	isnull(convert(varchar(15),[ModifiedDuration]),'') ModifiedDuration ,
	isnull(convert(varchar(15),[RestrictionID]),'') RestrictionID,
	isnull(convert(varchar(15),[RestrictionPercentage]),'') RestrictionPercentage ,
	isnull([RestrictionNotes],'') RestrictionNotes ,
	isnull([Text1],'') Text1 ,
	isnull([Text2],'') Text2 ,
	isnull([Text3],'') Text3 ,
	isnull([Text4],'') Text4 ,
	isnull([Text5],'') Text5 ,
	isnull(convert(varchar(15),[ConstructionManagerID]),'') ConstructionManagerID ,
	isnull(convert(varchar(15),[SuperID]),'') SuperID ,
	isnull(convert(varchar(15),[GeneralForemanID]),'') GeneralForemanID ,
	isnull(convert(varchar(15),[FieldEngineerID]),'') FieldEngineerID ,
	isnull(convert(varchar(15),[CoordinatorID]),'') CoordinatorID ,

	isnull(convert(varchar(30),[CompletedDate]),'') CompletedDate ,

        (select StatusDescription from [dbo].[SP_IWPStatus] a where a.ID = [dbo].[SP_ConstructionWorkPack].IWPStatusID) IWP_Status,
       (select f.ProgressStatus from [dbo].[v_ConstructionWorkPack] f where f.Name = [dbo].[SP_ConstructionWorkPack].name) Progress_Status,
	(select ltrim(rtrim(LastName)) + ' ' + ltrim(rtrim(FirstName))  from [dbo].[TM_Employee] where ID = [SuperID]) Supervisor_Name   ,
	(select ltrim(rtrim(LastName)) + ' ' + ltrim(rtrim(FirstName))  from [dbo].[TM_Employee] where ID = ConstructionManagerID) Construction_Manager_Name   ,

sqlReaderQuery.value:
select a.*,b.Requirement_Name as Mandatory from ql_Person_Qualification a,
 (Select pers.Id_Number,
					rqc.ql_Qualification_Id
					,rqp.Requirement_Name
 
 
	From Person pers
	Left Join Posting posti on pers.Id_Number=posti.Id_Number
        Left Join Grade g on g.Grade_sht_Title=pers.Grade_sht_Title 
	Left Join Post on posti.Post_Id=Post.Post_Id
 
	
	join Role on g.Spare_Char_1_255 =Role.Role_id
	Join  ql_Requirement_Structure rqp on rqp.Parent_Key=Role.Role_id
	Left Join ql_Requirement_Structure rqc on rqp.ql_req_struct_Id = rqc.Parent_ql_struct_Id
	where rqp.Parent_Key IS NOT NULL
	And Role.Role_Name NOT LIKE '%!Closed%'
	And pers.Date_Leaving>Getdate()
	
	And (posti.Posting_sDate=(Select max(posti2.Posting_sDate) from Posting posti2 where posti.Id_Number=posti2.Id_number and posti2.Posting_sDate<=GetDate()) OR posti.Posting_sDate IS NULL)
	) b 
	

where a.Id_Number=b.Id_Number
and a.ql_Qualification_Id=b.ql_Qualification_Id
and a.Date_Last_mod > '@{activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.start_date}'

oracleReaderQuery.value:
SELECT 
DISTINCT eci.proj_id PROJECT
,  eci.r_code PSR_R_CODE
, ecin.description PSR_DESCRIPTION
, eci.client_po_number PSR_PO_NUMBER
, (SELECT attr_value FROM m_sys.m_used_values WHERE used_type = 'ECI' AND pk_id=eci.eci_id AND attr_id = (SELECT MAX(attr_id) FROM m_sys.m_attrs WHERE attr_code = 'MDR_SUB_FUNCTION')) PSR_SUB_FUNCTION
, (SELECT attr_value FROM m_sys.m_used_values WHERE used_type = 'ECI' AND pk_id=eci.eci_id AND attr_id = (SELECT MAX(attr_id) FROM m_sys.m_attrs WHERE attr_code = '9 COM NUMBER')) PSR_9COM_NUMBER
, (SELECT attr_value FROM m_sys.m_used_values WHERE used_type = 'ECI' AND pk_id=eci.eci_id AND attr_id = (SELECT MAX(attr_id) FROM m_sys.m_attrs WHERE attr_code = 'VENDOR NAME')) PSR_VENDOR_NAME
, (SELECT attr_value FROM m_sys.m_used_values WHERE used_type = 'ECI' AND pk_id=eci.eci_id AND attr_id = (SELECT MAX(attr_id) FROM m_sys.m_attrs WHERE attr_code = 'SOURCE/LOCATION')) PSR_SOURCE_LOCATION
, (SELECT attr_value FROM m_sys.m_used_values WHERE used_type = 'ECI' AND pk_id=eci.eci_id AND attr_id = (SELECT MAX(attr_id) FROM m_sys.m_attrs WHERE attr_code = 'PROJECT_CRITICAL_PACKAGE')) PSR_CRITICAL_PACKAGE
, (SELECT attr_value FROM m_sys.m_used_values WHERE used_type = 'ECI' AND pk_id=eci.eci_id AND attr_id = (SELECT MAX(attr_id) FROM m_sys.m_attrs WHERE attr_code = 'TAGGED/BULK')) PSR_TAGGED_BULK
, mc.mc_code
, mc.order_seq mc_seq
, ms.scheduled_date planned_date
, ms.planned_date forecasted_date
, ms.actual_date actual_date
, eci.estimated_ros_date PSR_ROS_DATE
, eci.mset_id pset_id
, (SELECT attr_value FROM m_sys.m_used_values WHERE used_type = 'ECI' AND pk_id = eci.eci_id AND attr_id = (SELECT MAX(attr_id) FROM m_sys.m_attrs WHERE attr_code = 'WEEKS (EXW)')) PSR_WEEKS_EXW
, (SELECT attr_value FROM m_sys.m_used_values WHERE used_type = 'ECI' AND pk_id = eci.eci_id AND attr_id = (SELECT MAX(attr_id) FROM m_sys.m_attrs WHERE attr_code = 'TRANSIT TIME (WKS)')) PSR_TRANSIT_TIME
, (eci.estimated_ros_date- (select ms.scheduled_date from m_sys.m_milestones ms,m_sys.m_ms_configs mc where ms.eci_id =eci.eci_id and ms.mc_id=mc.mc_id and mc.mc_code='ETA')) PSR_FLOAT_MATERIALS
, (eci.estimated_ros_date- (select ms.planned_date from m_sys.m_milestones ms,m_sys.m_ms_configs mc where ms.eci_id =eci.eci_id and ms.mc_id=mc.mc_id and mc.mc_code='ETA')) PSR_FLOAT_MATERIALS_P
, eci.eci_comment PSR_REMARKS
FROM m_sys.m_eng_comm_items eci
    , m_sys.m_ms_sets mst
    , m_sys.m_eng_comm_item_nls ecin
    , m_sys.m_milestones ms
    , m_sys.m_ms_configs mc
WHERE eci.mset_id=mst.mset_id
    and ms.mc_id = mc.mc_id
    and eci.eci_id = ms.eci_id
    AND eci.proj_id= '@{pipeline().parameters.proj_id}'
    AND ecin.nls_id(+)= 1
    AND ecin.eci_id(+)=eci.eci_id
ORDER BY eci.proj_id, PSR_R_CODE, mc_seq

select DISTINCT

     , poh.approved_date PO_APPR_DATE
     , sup.sup_code supplier_code
     , c.company_name SUPPLIER_NAME
     , CY.CY_CODE SUPPLIER_COUNTRY
     , poli.poli_pos PO_ITEM_POS
     , poli.poli_sub_pos PO_ITEM_SUB
     , its.ish_pos ish_POS
     , its.ish_sub_pos ITEM_SHIP_SUB
     , replace( replace (replace (LTRIM(m_abb_sys.CONVERT_IMP_MET(its.ident,DECODE('@{activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.P_ZX_IMP_MET}','I','IMPERIAL','METRIC'),@{activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.p_nls_id})--P_ZX_IMP_MET--p_nls_id
       ||'; '|| m_abb_pck_bom.ident_cc_layout2(its.ident, 's',@{activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.p_nls_id}),--p_nls_id
       '-; '),chr(13), ' '),chr(10)) ,'�',' ' ) ITEM_DESC
    , its.ish_ident_code IDENT_CODE
    , ic.ic_code CLIENT_IDENT_CODE
     , its.ish_tag_number TAG_NO
     , its.ish_commodity_code COMMODITY_CODE
     , its.ish_input_1  size1
     , its.ish_input_2  size2
     , its.ish_input_3  size3
     , its.ish_input_4  size4
     , its.item_ship_id item_ship_id
     , nvl(poli.poli_qty,0) TOTAL_POLI_QT
     , its.ish_item_ship_qty ITEM_SHIP_QTY
     ,   DECODE (NVL(ish1.cnt,0),0, nvl(its.ish_received_qty,0), 
          DECODE (its.master_ish_id,NULL,
                  DECODE((nvl(ish1.tot_shipped,0) - nvl(ish1.tot_recv,0)),0,'999999999999999999999999999999',nvl(ish1.tot_recv,0)),
                  nvl(its.ish_received_qty,0)) ) RECD_QTY
     , unt.unit_code UOM
     , poli.poli_unit_price UNIT_PRICE
     , untC.unit_code CURRENCY
     , dd.dd_code DELIVERY_DEIGNATION
     , rm.rm_code ROUTING_METHOD
     , its.ish_rev_FRT_CODE INCOTERM
     , its.ish_rev_freight_value DELIVERY_PLACE
     , to_char(its.ish_prom_contract_date,'DD-Mon-YYYY') PROM_CONTRACT
     , to_char(its.ish_req_site_date,'DD-Mon-YYYY') ROS_DATE
     , reln.reln_number RN_NUMBER
     , to_char(reln.reln_date,'DD-Mon-YYYY') RN_DATE
     , nvl(its.ish_reln_qty,0) RN_QTY
     , reln.approved_date RB_APPR_DATE
     , reln.delv_date RN_DELIV_DATE
     , reln.READY_DATE RN_READY_DATE
     , irc.irct_number
     , irc.irct_date
     , irc.insp_date
     , its.ish_irc_qty IRC_QTY
     , mcs.mcs_number MCS_NR
     , TO_CHAR(mcs.mcs_date,'DD-Mon-YYYY') MCS_DATE
     , itsw.ish_des_code_exwo HAND_OVER_DEST
     , itsw.ish_planned_date_exwo HAND_OVER_PLAN
     , itsw.ish_forecasted_date_exwo HAND_OVER_FCST
     , itsw.ish_actual_date_exwo HAND_OVER_ACT
     , itsw.ish_des_code_ship_1  SHIP_DEST_1
     , itsw.ish_planned_date_ship_1 SHIP_PLAN_1
     , itsw.ish_forecasted_date_ship_1 SHIP_FCST_1
     , itsw.ish_actual_date_ship_1 SHIP_ACT_1
     , itsw.ish_des_code_ship_2  SHIP_DEST_2
     , itsw.ish_planned_date_ship_2 SHIP_PLAN_2
     , itsw.ish_forecasted_date_ship_2 SHIP_FCST_2
     , itsw.ish_actual_date_ship_2 SHIP_ACT_2
     , itsw.ish_des_code_ship_3  SHIP_DEST_3
     , itsw.ish_planned_date_ship_3 SHIP_PLAN_3
     , itsw.ish_forecasted_date_ship_3 SHIP_FCST_3
     , itsw.ish_actual_date_ship_3 SHIP_ACT_3
     , itsw.ish_des_code_ta  TRAFF_ARR_DEST
     , itsw.ish_planned_date_ta TRAFF_ARR_PLAN
     , itsw.ish_forecasted_date_ta TRAFF_ARR_FCST
     , itsw.ish_actual_date_ta TRAFF_ARR_ACT
     , itsw.ish_des_code_aos  ARR_ON_SITE_DEST
     , itsw.ish_planned_date_aos ARR_ON_SITE_PLAN
     , itsw.ish_forecasted_date_aos ARR_ON_SITE_FCST
     , itsw.ish_actual_date_aos ARR_ON_SITE_ACT
     , csh.carrier_name MOC_CARRIER
     , csh.voy_flt_num MOC_VOYFLT_NUM 
     , csh.vessel_name MOC_NAME_1
     , csh.vessel2_name MOC_NAME_2
     , to_char(csh.etd_date ,'DD-Mon-YYYY')  MOC_ETD
     , to_char(csh.atd_date ,'DD-Mon-YYYY')  MOC_ATD
     , to_char(csh.eta_date ,'DD-Mon-YYYY')  MOC_ETA 
     , to_char(csh.ata_date ,'DD-Mon-YYYY') MOC_ATA
     , csh.loading_point MOC_LOADING_PT
     , csh.unloading_point MOC_UNLOADING_POINT
     , to_char(csh.awb_number ) MOC_BOL
     , usrb.first_name ||' '||usrb.last_name BUYER
     , usre.first_name ||' '||usre.last_name EXPEDITER
     , its.ish_r_code REQUISITION
     , its.ish_r_supp REQ_SUPP
     , its.ish_rli_pos REQ_LI
     , its.ish_rli_sub_pos REQ_SUB_LI
     , jb.job_number ACCOUNT_NUMBER

     , to_char(sd2.forecasted_date,'DD-Mon-YYYY')  forecasted_del_date	--FORECASTED DEL DATE
     , sd1.des_code irc_dest										--IRC DEST
     , to_char(sd1.planned_date,'DD-Mon-YYYY') irc_plan				--IRC Plan date
     , to_char(sd1.forecasted_date,'DD-Mon-YYYY') irc_fcst				--IRC forecast date
     , to_char(sd1.actual_date,'DD-Mon-YYYY') irc_act					--IRC Actual date

from m_sys.m_po_headers poh, m_sys.m_companies c, m_sys.m_suppliers sup, m_sys.m_po_header_nls pohn 
     ,m_sys.m_company_addrs padrs, m_sys.m_addr_types adrtypes, m_sys.m_countries cy
     ,m_sys.m_po_line_items poli, m_sys.mvp_ish_all_reqs_workload its
     ,m_sys.m_units unt, m_sys.m_units untC, m_sys.m_delv_desigs dd, m_sys.m_routing_methods rm
     ,m_sys.MVP_ISH_WORKLOAD itsw
     ,m_sys.m_release_notes reln, m_sys.mvp_csd_workload csh , m_sys.m_users usrb, m_sys.m_jobs jb, m_sys.m_users usre
     ,m_sys.m_inspection_rel_certs irc
     ,m_sys.m_mcs_numbers mcs 
     ,(Select * from m_sys.m_ident_companies
           where company_id=@{activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.a_company_id}) ic --a_company_id         
     ,  (SELECT rp.base_poh_id,rp.r_id, rp.rli_id,rp.last_contact_date,rp.next_contact_date, rp.expediter,
              apoli.proj_id,apoli.poli_id
                FROM m_sys.m_actual_polis apoli,
                      m_sys.m_req_li_to_polis rltp,
                     m_sys.m_req_to_pos rp
                    WHERE rp.rli_id IS NULL and
                          rltp.r_id = rp.r_id
                          AND apoli.poli_id = rltp.poli_id 
                          AND EXISTS
                           (SELECT 1
                              FROM m_sys.m_po_to_base_pos ptbp
                             WHERE     ptbp.rp_id = rp.rp_id
                                   AND ptbp.poh_id = rltp.poh_id)
      ) all_rp

   ,( select a.poli_id POLI_ID, SUM(a.item_ship_qty) TOT_SHIPPED, 
            SUM(a.recv_on_site_qty) TOT_RECV,COUNT(a.poli_id) cnt
      from m_sys.m_item_ships a
      where 1=1 and master_ish_id is not null
       and a.proj_id = '@{activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.p_proj_id}' --p_proj_id
       group by a.poli_id) ish1

   ,(   select item_ship_id,des.des_code, itsd.planned_date, itsd.forecasted_date, itsd.actual_date  --Start of new table 1
            from m_sys.m_rm_schedules rms     
                ,m_sys.m_item_ship_dates itsd ,m_sys.m_destinations des
            where itsd.proj_id = '@{activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.p_proj_id}'			--p_proj_id
           --   and itsd.item_ship_id = p_data.item_ship_id--27239004
              and itsd.RMS_ID = rms.rms_id 
              and rms.des_id = des.des_id
              and rms.exped_date_type= 'IRC' )  SD1
  ,(   select isd.item_ship_id,isd.forecasted_date
     from m_sys.m_item_ship_dates isd,
          m_sys.m_rm_schedules rms
         , m_sys.m_item_ships ish
    where --ish.item_ship_id = p_data.item_ship_id and
       rms.rm_id(+) = ish.rm_id
      and rms.delv_date_ind(+) = 'Y'
      and isd.proj_id = '@{activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.p_proj_id}'				--p_proj_id			
      and ish.proj_id = '@{activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.p_proj_id}'			--p_proj_id
      and isd.item_ship_id = ish.item_ship_id
      and isd.rms_id(+) = rms.rms_id) SD2

where poh.proj_id = '@{activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.p_proj_id}' --p_proj_id
and poh.po_number like '@{activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.A_EXP_PO}'--A_EXP_PO
and sup.sup_id(+) = poh.sup_id
and c.company_id(+) = sup.company_id
and pohn.poh_id(+) = poh.poh_id
and pohn.nls_id(+) = @{activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.p_nls_id} --p_nls_id
and adrtypes.address_type_code = 'MAIL TO'
and padrs.company_id = c.company_id  
and padrs.address_type_id = adrtypes.address_type_id 
and padrs.cy_id = cy.cy_id
and poli.poh_id = poh.poh_id
and its.poli_id = poli.poli_id
and its.proj_id = poh.proj_id
and NVL(its.ish_item_ship_qty,0)<>0 
and ic.ident(+) = its.ident
and unt.unit_id = its.qty_unit_id
and untC.unit_id = poli.currency_id
and dd.dd_id(+) = its.dd_id
and rm.rm_id(+) = its.rm_id
and itsw.item_ship_id(+) = its.item_ship_id
and itsw.proj_id = '@{activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.p_proj_id}'   --p_proj_id                           
and reln.reln_id(+) = its.reln_id
and csh.reln_id(+) = reln.reln_id
and usrb.m_usr_id = poh.buyer
and irc.irct_id (+)= its.irct_id  
and mcs.mcs_id (+) = its.mcs_id 
and usre.m_usr_id(+) = all_rp.expediter                             
and all_rp.proj_id(+) = its.proj_id
and all_rp.poli_id(+) = its.poli_id
and all_rp.base_poh_id = poh.base_poh_id
and jb.job_id(+) = poli.job_id
and its.poli_id = ish1.poli_id (+)

and sd1.item_ship_id(+) = its.item_ship_id  --New table Join condition
and sd2.item_ship_id(+) = its.item_ship_id   --New table Join condition

and decode('@{activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.A_PR_SUPP}','%','1',sup.sup_code)=decode('@{activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.A_PR_SUPP}','%','1','@{activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.A_PR_SUPP}') --A_PR_SUPP
and ((reln.approved_date is not null and UPPER(SUBSTR('@{activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.A_APPR_RN}' , 1, 1)) = 'Y')--A_APPR_RN
      or (reln.approved_date is null and UPPER(SUBSTR('@{activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.A_APPR_RN}' , 1, 1)) = 'N')--A_APPR_RN	
      or (1=1 and UPPER(SUBSTR('@{activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.A_APPR_RN}' , 1, 1)) = '%')
    )
and ((itsw.ish_actual_date_aos is not null and UPPER(SUBSTR('@{activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.A_AOS_ACT}' , 1, 1)) = 'Y')--A_AOS_ACT
      or (itsw.ish_actual_date_aos is null and UPPER(SUBSTR('@{activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.A_AOS_ACT}' , 1, 1)) = 'N')--A_AOS_ACT
      or (1=1 and UPPER(SUBSTR('@{activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.A_AOS_ACT}', 1, 1)) = '%')--A_AOS_ACT
    )
order by   
    POH.PO_NUMBER,poli.poli_pos, poli.poli_sub_pos,its.ish_pos,its.ish_sub_pos,POH.PO_SUPP;

scripts.text:
insert into [rpy].[Project_Elements_Data]
(ATTRIBUTE1,ATTRIBUTE10,ATTRIBUTE11,ATTRIBUTE12,ATTRIBUTE13,ATTRIBUTE14,ATTRIBUTE15,ATTRIBUTE2,
ATTRIBUTE3,ATTRIBUTE4,ATTRIBUTE5,ATTRIBUTE6,ATTRIBUTE7,ATTRIBUTE8,ATTRIBUTE9,BILLABLE_FLAG,
CARRYING_OUT_ORGANIZATION_ID,CHARGEABLE_FLAG,COMPLETION_DATE,DESCRIPTION,ELEMENT_NUMBER,
LAST_UPDATE_DATE,NAME,PROJECT_ID,PROJ_ELEMENT_ID,START_DATE,source_name,sub_source_name,created_date_time)
select a.ATTRIBUTE1,a.ATTRIBUTE10,a.ATTRIBUTE11,a.ATTRIBUTE12,a.ATTRIBUTE13,a.ATTRIBUTE14,a.ATTRIBUTE15,a.ATTRIBUTE2,a.
ATTRIBUTE3,a.ATTRIBUTE4,a.ATTRIBUTE5,a.ATTRIBUTE6,a.ATTRIBUTE7,a.ATTRIBUTE8,a.ATTRIBUTE9,a.BILLABLE_FLAG,a.
CARRYING_OUT_ORGANIZATION_ID,a.CHARGEABLE_FLAG,a.COMPLETION_DATE,a.DESCRIPTION,a.ELEMENT_NUMBER,a.
LAST_UPDATE_DATE,a.NAME,a.PROJECT_ID,a.PROJ_ELEMENT_ID,a.START_DATE,a.source_name,a.sub_source_name,a.created_date_time
from [rpy].[Project_Elements_Data_stage] a,
(select PROJ_ELEMENT_ID,LAST_UPDATE_DATE,max(ID) as ID 
from [rpy].[Project_Elements_Data_stage]
group by PROJ_ELEMENT_ID,LAST_UPDATE_DATE) b
where a.PROJ_ELEMENT_ID = b.PROJ_ELEMENT_ID
and a.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = b.LAST_UPDATE_DATE

SELECT r.PROJ_ID 
,d.DP_CODE as Discipline
,r.R_CODE as Requisition_no
,r.R_SUPP as Supp
,r.ACTUAL_IND
,r.MR_REVISION
,r.SR_REVISION
,R_ORIGIN_CODE
,rst.RST_CODE as Status--revision_id
--,decode(R_RELEASE_CONTEXT, 'ALL','All Quantities','SHQ','Shortage Quantities','SUQ','Surplus Quantities','CHQ','Changed Quantities','NLI','New Line Items')
,APPROVED_BY
,APPROVED_DATE
,ORIGINATOR
,REL_TO_PROC_BY
,REL_TO_PROC_DATE
,BUYER
,PROC_ACKNOWLEDGE_DATE
,INQ_COMPLETE_IND
,PO_COMPLETE_IND
--,R_ATTRIBUTE_1
,ORIGINAL_BUDGET
,replace(replace(n.SHORT_DESC,'|',' '),',',' ')as Short_Description
,replace(replace(n.DESCRIPTION,'|',' '),',',' ') as DESCRIPTION
--,m_pck_req_util.get_rnd_codes (r.rnd_id, '/', 255)
,MT.MTY_CODE
,MJ.MJ_CODE
,MTE.RTP_CODE
,mrn.rnd_code
,mrd.RSD_CODE
,CREATED_DATE 
FROM 
  M_SYS.m_reqs r, 
  m_sys.m_req_status rst,
  m_sys.mvp_er_workload  w,
  m_sys.m_disciplines  d,
  M_SYS.M_REQ_NLS n,
  m_sys.m_mto_types mt,
  m_sys.m_mto_jobs mj, 
  m_sys.m_req_templs mte,
  m_sys.m_req_nodes mrn, 
  m_sys.m_req_set_details mrd
where d.dp_id(+) = r.dp_id  
and w.r_id(+)   = r.R_ID  
and n.r_id(+)   = r.R_ID
and mt.mty_id(+)   = r.mty_id 
and mt.proj_id(+)  = r.proj_id --
and mj.mj_id(+)    = r.mj_id 
and mj.proj_id(+)  = r.proj_id --
and mte.rtp_id(+)  = r.rtp_id 
and mte.proj_id(+) = r.proj_id --
and mrn.rnd_id(+)  = r.rnd_id 
and mrn.proj_id(+) = r.proj_id --
and mrd.rsd_id(+)  = r.rsd_id 
and mrd.proj_id(+) = r.proj_id
and r.rst_id = rst.rst_id 
and r.r_supp in(          
(select  max(r_supp) r_supp from m_sys.m_reqs
where r_code =r.r_code
and   rst.proj_id   = r.Proj_id))
and r.proj_id = '@{pipeline().parameters.proj_id}'

oracleReaderQuery.value:
SELECT DISTINCT 
  r.proj_id, r.r_code, rn.description, r.r_supp supplement, decode(actual_ind, 'Y', 'P', 'I') inq_pur_ind, r.approved_date, rli.RLI_POS itemno, rli.RLI_sub_POS itemsub  
, i.IDENT_CODE ident, cc.commodity_code, i.input_1, i.input_2, i.input_3, i.input_4, i.input_5
, substr(UPPER(m_pck_std_custom.ident_desc(rli.ident, 1)),1,400) IDENT_DESCRIPTION
, to_char(rli.TOTAL_RELEASE_QTY) total_qty  
, to_char(nvl(rli.total_release_qty,0) - NVL(rli.last_total_release_qty,0)) increased_qty
, m_pck_req_custom.WEIGHT(rli.ident) unit_weight
, upper(u2.unit_code) weight_code      
, job_number accountcode
, upper(u1.unit_code) qty_unit
, dd.dd_code "Delivery Designation"
, rli.estimated_ros_date ROS_Date                                                       
, rli.tag_number  tag_number     
--, client_code 
, m_abb_pck_bom.ident_cc_layout2(i.ident,'L',1) "Long Description"
, nvl(rli.rli_comment, '') "Comment"
FROM 
  m_sys.m_reqs r,
  m_sys.m_req_line_items rli,
  m_sys.m_req_status rst,
  m_sys.m_req_nls rn,
  m_sys.m_jobs j,
  m_sys.m_units u1,                                                  
  m_sys.M_UNITS u2,  
  m_sys.m_idents i,
  m_sys.m_commodity_codes cc,
  m_sys.m_delv_desigs dd
WHERE 1=1
  AND r.r_id = rli.r_id
  AND r.rst_id = rst.rst_id 
  AND r.r_id = rn.r_id 
  AND rli.dd_id = dd.dd_id 
  AND rli.job_id = j.job_id (+) 
  AND rli.ident =  i.ident  
  AND i.commodity_id = cc.commodity_id  
  AND u1.unit_id = rli.qty_unit_id 
  AND upper(u2.unit_id) = rli.weight_UNIT_ID
  AND r.approved_date is not null  -- not needed Moses, 19-Nov 
  AND r.proj_id = '@{pipeline().parameters.proj_id}'
  ORDER BY r.r_code,r.r_supp,rli.rli_pos,rli.rli_sub_pos
